![Figure 5](assets/figures/figure_05_sex_difference.png)

<div class="figcaption"><strong>Figure 5.</strong> Difference in P-scores over time between females and males, pooled for selected high-vaccination and low-vaccination European countries and US states.</div>

Positive values indicate higher P-scores among females. European trajectories
use a three-week moving average; dotted lines show 95% credible intervals.
